description: Cross-repo conformance vector for the ATTESTATION KEY-SET SELECTION layer (rotation). The producer (corelink-runners fabric) serves GET /v1/attestation/key as a key set; the consumer (hugit v2 verifier) must SELECT the entry whose key_id matches the attestation and reject unknown/expired keys BEFORE the existing single-key crypto verify. This pins the selection DECISIONS so both repos agree byte-for-byte (transcribe-not-design). Companion to attestation_key_set.json, which pins the RESPONSE SHAPE + the DEV key_id derivation. Selection matches key_id by string equality; the pubkey_b64 is opaque to selection. Reference selector: corelink_fabric_api::select_attestation_key.
